clashes.keepBothText_one: The new file gets a number: {{example}}.
clashes.keepBothText_other: The new files get a number, like {{example}}.
clashes.replaceText_one: The file in {{target}} goes to the Recycle Bin; its tags move to the new one.
clashes.replaceText_other: Files in {{target}} go to the Recycle Bin; their tags move to the new ones.

clashes.skipText_other: Files in {{target}} stay; the new ones with those names aren't added.
